title: Invader
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 5254 (addresses via C2 ra_notes.py)
notes: Genre: Shooter. Live values from RA notes, not checked in a running game unless said. PC mGBA sweep (boot, mash, walk; C2 gbaverify): lives 4 -> 3 -> 2 -> 0 and score 100/200/300 as invaders were shot. C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text: Space Invaders style: move the cannon, shoot the descending invader waves.
widgets.label: How it plays

widgets.text: Lower rows score least, top rows most; the mystery UFO gives bonus points.
widgets.label: Points

widgets.text: Clear one column at the edge to slow their reach. The last invader moves fastest.
widgets.label: Tips

widgets.text: Waves start lower each time you clear one.
widgets.label: Structure

widgets.text: Bunkers block shots both ways and wear down.
widgets.label: Shields

widgets.text: Survive as many waves as possible.
widgets.label: Goal
